addrEn: Nanqingzhen Rd, in the Hui (Muslim) quarter off Xiaoxi Rd
hours: About 8:00–16:00. Friday prayer time not published; ask there
why: The oldest, biggest mosque in Northeast China, in a neighborhood of halal butchers and snacks. Friday Oct 16 is Jumu'ah.

addrEn: 235 Zhongjie Rd. Branches change, check Dianping
why: Halal since 1796. Steamed lamb shaomai. Next to the palace and Zhongjie.

how: Metro Line 1 to Zhongjie (中街), exit B
why: The Qing emperors' first palace, a small Forbidden City.

addrEn: Zhongjie Rd, north of the palace
why: The oldest walking street in the Northeast. Lights, snacks, people-watching.

addr: 沈河区朝阳街少帅府巷46号
addrEn: 46 Shaoshuaifu Lane, a walk from the palace
why: Home of the warlord Zhang Zuolin. Chinese and European buildings side by side.

how: Metro Line 2 to Beiling Park (北陵公园)
why: A huge park around an emperor's tomb (UNESCO). Autumn colors right now.

hours: Usually closed Mondays. Book on Dianping
why: One of China's best for painting and calligraphy.
Neon, 300+ restaurants, very lively. Most food here is pork BBQ, so walk it, don't eat it.

how: Metro Line 7 to Guang'anmennei (广安门内), ~700 m
hours: About 8:00–17:00. Friday prayer around 13:00 (one traveller report)
why: Beijing's oldest mosque (996 AD), in the Hui quarter. Friday Oct 23 is fair day 3: about 1h+ from the fair.

how: Metro Line 7 to Guang'anmennei (广安门内), exit B
why: Famous copper-pot lamb hotpot on the Muslim street. Halal per the area, but look for the 清真 sign.

zh: 东来顺饭庄(王府井总店)
why: Halal lamb hotpot since 1903. Then walk Wangfujing street.
Halal banquet house since 1853. Whole lamb, oxtail. Good for a celebration dinner.

addrEn: Huairou, about 45 min by car from the fair
why: Closest Great Wall to the fair, and calmer than Badaling. Take the toboggan down.

how: Metro Line 1 to Tiananmen East (天安门东)
hours: Closed Mondays. Tickets open 7 days ahead at 20:00; book with your passport
why: The must-see. Best days: Oct 20 (arrival) or Oct 25.
Big lit-up shopping street. Pair it with Donglaishun.

how: Metro Line 5 or 6 to Dongsi (东四)
hours: Friday time not published; ask there
why: Home of the Beijing Islamic Association. Central and easy to reach.
